(i) Express h in terms of x and show that the total surface area of the prism, A cm^{2}, is given by A = ï23x^{2} + (24 000 -1)/(3)ï x. [3] (ii) Given that x can vary, find the value of x for which A has a stationary value. [3] (iii) Determine, showing all necessary working, the nature of this stationary value. [2]
